meta.title: XML Formatter - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Beautify and validate XML documents. Format XML with proper indentation.
steps_xml-formatter_1Desc: Paste minified or messy XML into the input area. The formatter handles nested elements, attributes, CDATA sections, and processing instructions.
steps_xml-formatter_2Desc: Click Format to pretty-print with proper indentation. Validation catches mismatched tags, unclosed elements, and structural errors with clear messages.
steps_xml-formatter_3Desc: Click Copy to grab the clean, indented XML. Perfect for reviewing configuration files, SOAP responses, or any XML-based data format.
desc: Beautify and validate XML documents. Format XML with proper indentation.
